questions.stem: One strand of DNA reads 5′-TGAAAAAG-3′. What is the sequence of the complementary strand, written 5′ to 3′?

questions.stem: A cross is expected to produce offspring in a 9 : 3 : 3 : 1 ratio. The observed counts are 123, 57, 45, 15 (total 240). Using a chi-square test at p = 0.05 (critical values: 3.84 for 1 df, 5.99 for 2 df, 7.81 for 3 df), which conclusion is correct?
